name: A2
messages: I’ll read the API contract and query each alias once, then report the status and what it establishes about delivery or another payment request.

All five queries returned HTTP 200.

| Alias | Observed status | Enough information and authority to deliver? | To request another payment? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| demo-open | OPEN | No | No | Observed open; no remaining-time guarantee. |
| demo-partial | PARTIAL | No | No | Partially paid, possibly past expiry; do not instruct another payment. |
| demo-paid | PAID | No | No | Reconciler reports paid; delivery is not authorized. |
| demo-expired | EXPIRED | No | No | Expired; later payment remains possible. |
| demo-late | PAID_LATE | No | No | Paid late; merchant policy is required. |

These are changeable observations, never permission for business actions. The API supplies neither timestamps nor merchant policy. No deadline was assumed, and neither action was performed.
